title: Scoped Narrative State Hierarchy
objective: Define explicit scoped narrative state across universe/setting, World, Campaign, Session, Scene/location, entity/NPC, encounter and temporary execution scopes without creating a hidden undifferentiated canonical flag namespace.

scope.purpose: Establish inspectable narrative state scope, lifetime and provenance semantics over existing owner projections without becoming canonical Story, World, Character, NPC, Scene, Campaign or other owner-domain state authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative narrative state can be declared, resolved and inspected deterministically across explicit scopes and lifetimes with owner/provenance retained, while conflicts or ambiguous hidden-global-state behavior fail closed.

selection_boundaries: CNI-02 is completed_verified before CNI-03 implementation.
CNI-03 consumes existing World, Campaign, Session, Scene/location, Character/NPC, encounter and other owner projections rather than replacing their canonical state authority.
Narrative state must carry explicit scope identity, lifetime, owner authority/reference and provenance.
No undifferentiated global flag namespace or implicit fallback may become hidden canonical truth.
Action/Event and owner domains retain canonical mutation authority; CNI-03 performs no owner-domain mutation.
Derived narrative values remain projections over declared inputs and are not silently persisted as owner truth.
PCA is milestone-eligible after CNI-02 but remains unselected and unauthorized.
CNI-04+, PCA and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
Only work/cni-03-scoped-narrative-state-hierarchy has implementation authority for this attempt.

implementation_plan.name: RED scoped narrative state hierarchy acceptance seam
Deterministic CNI-03 scoped state declaration/resolution contract
Source-governance proof over owner-domain, provenance and mutation boundaries
Exact-head verification, merge and OPS3 closeout

next_action: Create the authorized application branch and establish causal RED before production implementation.
